reviewMethod: Independently read all 166 initially retained complete English/Chinese pairs, meanings and POS against all frozen Chinese definitions, POS, lexical evidence and variants in untruncated show-review-pack chunks 0+30, 30+30, 60+30, 90+30, 120+30 and 150+20; separately read all 34 author-deferred complete frozen records, covering the whole 200-entry queue without approving the deferred records. All 200 frozen meanings/POS/variants were also compared with actual canonical dictionary records; absent variants and [] were normalized as no variants. Evidence here is published-Chinese-source-only, not exact WordNet or automatic morphological equivalence. Individually checked actual head use, grammar/POS, published-sense fidelity, naturalness, translation precision, register and concrete non-definitional use. Preserved the initially fully read 166-row TSV byte-for-byte in qa/b-original-read-p032.tsv. After root-authorised author-only corrections, reread the seven complete final changed rows and every full frozen field/evidence/variant for good at, durant, eunice, tulsa, macy, bailie and inarticulateness. Exact subset comparison confirms middle atlantic is the sole removal, the other 158 complete rows are byte-identical in fields and order, and only the seven authorised rows changed. Final compiled 165 entries exactly equal the locked final TSV; the exact current source hash is pinned. Mechanical checks establish freshness/provenance and do not replace the full language read.
